title: The 2-Minute Lie Your Brain Tells You
topic: Disturbing human brain glitches and illusions science cannot explain
script: Did you ever experience a moment where you're certain you're walking down the street, but when you turn around, you're not sure where you are? It's not just a minor glitch, it's a recurring phenomenon that can be found in over 75% of people. Our brains are wired to deceive us, to create false realities that make us feel safe and in control. But what if your reality is just a simulation? What if the world you think you know is actually a never-ending loop of déjà vu? Can you escape the cycle, or will you be trapped forever?
